verdict.rationale: A state business-filing agency could plausibly publish plain-language founder guidance, so this axis applies. The evidence pack holds only robots.txt probes showing the SCC sites disallow all crawling. Nothing was fetched about guidance content, so there is no evidence that step-by-step, non-lawyer explainers exist.
